title: Remove tensor padding (199.32× smaller uniform-rank exponent)
body:
The original overlapping-rank flow could accumulate leaf exits too quickly to justify near-root convergence. This changes its stopping height and supplies a uniformly funded recursive majorant. The resulting direct compiler accepts three raw native profiles without chronological tensor padding, paid completion or splitting.

For p16, the sufficient uniform rank falls from **`2^558100005581` to `2^2800000000`**, a **199.32× smaller exponent**, while retaining the **same uniform saving, outer parameter point and conditional κ = 0.00302015** as [PR #4479](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4479). The initial native supplier uses tensor power **1 instead of 682**. This is a compiler improvement; it does not claim a new κ.

### What changes

The new package, `research/rank-convergence/`, contains an arbitrary-height integer forest, two complementary Chernoff bounds, an exact mirror-window boundary certificate, sharp source/exit cancellation, and a concave shifted-logarithmic majorant with its entire base range and final rank funded. Exact rational gates cover every local exponent and all larger heights. This supplies a convergence argument for profiles satisfying the gates; no universal gate-existence theorem is claimed.

| Profile | Retained conditional κ | Prior H | New H | Reduction in H |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P7, same saving as [PR #4480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4480)'s unchanged-C witness | .00268647 | 130,200,000,000 | 3,040,000,000 | 42.83× |
| [PR #4453](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4453) native profile, same saving as [PR #4480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4480)'s main witness | .00300120 | 125,790,000,000 | 4,300,000,000 | 29.25× |
| [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470) p16 profile, same saving as [PR #4479](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4479) | .00302015 | 558,100,005,581 | **2,800,000,000** | **199.32×** |

Here `N=2^H`. A fourth certificate gives H=1,300,000,000 for the native4453 profile using its original consumer's weaker saving requirement; the 29.25× comparison above holds that requirement fixed.

### Predecessors and related PRs

- My [PR #4359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4359) κ=.0023 construction and cumulative native/outer lineage, [PR #4436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4436) integer overlapping flow, [PR #4453](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4453) native retiming, and [PR #4480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4480) net-tax/log-moment compiler.
- Ryanson Jonathan's corrected [PR #4459](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4459) mirror identity. Its withdrawn earlier reduction is not used.
- The finite-flow, leaf and width analyses in [PR #4456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4456), [PR #4465](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4465), [PR #4467](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4467), and [PR #4476](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4476).
- Cinna Davis's [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470) joint-helper native construction and Dugongue's [PR #4479](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4479) compact compiler and comparison point.

Credit Jacob Alan Sussman's integer compiler and all retained BIT, scalar, Clifford, geometry, helper/controller and outer sources. `SOURCES.json` authenticates exact inputs, including original Sussman license and notice. The diff includes byte-for-byte predecessor packages absent from main so their pending inputs remain available; the new mathematics and code are confined to `research/rank-convergence/`. Shared documentation matches canonical main. Retention is not scientific admission of those pending packages.

### Validation and limits

- Registered replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-convergence` passed.
- Four exact certificates, 13 test methods, 80 literal fixtures, 24 independent ordered-word flow comparisons and eight rejected numerical witnesses.
- Committed-byte preflight and checked 26-file export passed. The exported package reproduced with no Git, `PATH=/nonexistent` and `python3.12 -I -O -B`; source and receipt mutation controls rejected corruption.
- Native and outer producer receipts are inherited and authenticated, not freshly replayed. Physical, precision, analytic, finite-program and exact-recovery premises remain inherited. Winning words are not materialized; the smaller ambient rank is not a practical width/runtime or eventual multiplication-input threshold claim. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Known baseline CI issue: four existing current-status/navigation tests fail on unchanged canonical main `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`, as reproduced during [PR #4480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4480). No frozen verifier or historical source is changed to bypass them. Hosted validation for this PR must be assessed on its actual run.

Open next questions cover changed native profiles for an actual κ gain, broader compiler admission gates, and complete physical constants. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including three Sol 6.1 medium subagents and separate author-side audits; no formal or independent human verification is claimed. Apache-2.0.
